name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Outstanding Achievement By An Individual
targetBeneficiaries: Individuals providing services in substance abuse prevention and rehabilitation
briefDescription: This central scheme recognizes and encourages individuals for their outstanding services and excellence in the prevention of alcoholism and substance (drug) abuse.
descriptionMd: This scheme aims to recognize and encourage individuals who have made significant contributions in the field of prevention of alcoholism and substance (drug) abuse. It seeks to acknowledge excellence in services provided for the prevention of addiction and the rehabilitation of its victims. The awards highlight the most effective and outstanding efforts in this crucial area.
benefitsMd:
- Recognition through a national award for outstanding service.
- Encouragement of excellence in the field of prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse.
- Public acknowledgement of efforts in victim rehabilitation.
eligibilityMd:
- The applicant must be an individual.
- The individual must have demonstrated outstanding achievement.
- The achievement must be in the field of prevention of alcoholism and substance (drug) abuse.
- The services rendered must be effective or outstanding.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
